descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
The puck drops. The crowd is on its feet. It is your ice.

REAL STICK, REAL HANDS
Your hands are hockey gloves and the stick is always in them. Hold it the way you play: right hand on top for a left shot, left hand on top for a right shot, or let the game pick for you. The gloves wrap the shaft naturally, and the blade handles, passes and fires the puck with real physics.

FIVE WAYS TO PLAY
MATCH: a 3-minute game, Storm against Blaze, with faceoffs, a live scoreboard and a final card. Your AI linemates pass to you and the other side carries, passes, shoots and checks the puck off you.
SHOOTOUT: five shots against the goalie. He drops into the butterfly, so pick your spot.
TARGETS: 60 seconds to hit the four corner targets as many times as you can.
HARDEST SHOT: wind up and let it fly. The radar reads your speed in km/h.
PRACTICE: free skate with as many pucks as you like.

THREE LEVELS
Easy, Pro and All-Star goalies and opponents. Your personal bests are saved.

PLAY ONLINE
Quick Match finds a game in seconds, or open a private room and share its 4-digit code. Up to 4 players on the ice with a goalie in each net, and optional voice chat. Mute, block and report are always one click away.

THE ARENA
A packed bowl of fans, a centre-hung scoreboard, glass, boards and banners, with arena music you can switch or turn off.
